fields.name: url
fields.doc: Canonical URI of the source text object.

fields.name: rownum
fields.doc: 1-based physical line number within the source object.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.doc: UTC instant captured from the line header, at microsecond resolution.

fields.name: timepartition
fields.doc: Timestamp partitioned by its UTC hour in Iceberg.

fields.name: threadId
fields.doc: Bridge thread identifier captured from the line header.

fields.name: sessionUid
fields.doc: Bridge session identifier captured from a message-context header.

fields.name: msgCtxId
fields.doc: Bridge message-context identifier captured from the line header.

fields.name: seqNum
fields.doc: Bridge sequence number captured from a message-context header.

fields.name: pluginid
fields.doc: Bridge plugin that logged the line, and the dialect it is read under.

fields.name: level
fields.doc: Severity spelling captured from the line header.

fields.name: bodyhash
fields.doc: XXH3-128 digest of the exact body bytes, filled during field apply.

fields.name: body
fields.doc: Exact bytes after the matched line-header prefix.
